ns2:section.sectionText: Section C2 is offered in a self-paced, online format. Students registered for section C should access the course's Compass site before August 22 for further information about the course requirements and procedures. To be added to a wait list for this class, go to http://hcd.uiuc.edu/student_information/courses/waitlist.html and follow Wait List Instructions.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
